title: Hussain Zinda Hai Shaheed Zinda Hai
body:
Hussain Zinda Hai Shaheed Zinda Hai
khuda Ka Kehna Hai Shaheed Zinda Hai
1. Kaha Tha Zehra Se Nabi Ne Ro Ro Kar
karenge Gham Sheh Ka Muhib Tere Ro Kar
azal Ka Waada Nibhaya Jaata Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kahega Mehshar Me Yeh Khaleq-e-akbar
hai Matam-e-sarwar Najaat Ka Mehwar
hussain Ka Jo Hai Wohi Hamara Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Luta Ke Ghar Apna Hussain Kehte Hai
kata Ke Sar Apna Hussain Kehte Ha
yu'n Wada-e-tifli Nibhaya Jata Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hussain Ke Saathi Toh Mar Nahi Sakte
kata Ke Sar Apna Woh Mar Nahi Sakte
yeh Haq Ka Kehna Hai Shaheed Zinda Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Karenge Duniya Me Hussain Ka Matam
gar Aaye Toofa'n Bhi Na Hoga Phir Bhi Kam
yeh Matam-e-sarwar Dua-e-zehra Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hussain Ke Jaisa Na Ban Saka Koi
baya'n Hai Khaleq Ka Na Ban Saka Koi
tamaam Duniya Me Wohi Akela Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Yeh Hashmi Saber Hain Noukar-e-sarwar
ataa Hai Sarwar Ki Karam Hai Yeh Unpar
aza Ki Duniya Me Dua-e-zehra Hai
